newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 cent firmer.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 cent firmer.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open 0.05 cent firmer Wednesday, dealers said.
Thin and rangebound activity is anticipated so long as spot March remains below 10.47 cents a lb where it has stalled several times in the past week, analysts said.
Firmer resistance was seen at 10.52 cents, where dealers expect fund and commission house buying to emerge.
High open interest with about three weeks remaining until the March contract expires, should provide support around present levels, Merrill Lynch said in a daily sugar comment.
Open interest in March stood at 62,567 lots.
CSCE world sugar futures ended barely higher Tuesday, with March 0.02 firmer at 10.44, traded 10.36 to 10.46. The back months ended 0.03 lower to 0.01 higher.
LIFFE white sugar was firmer. The March contract was trading $1.70 higher at $301.30, and the back months were up $0.50 to $1.60, at 0850 EST/1350 GMT.
